correctness.rationale: For n>=3, selected outside-neighbor counts must lie in {1,2} at every unselected vertex in a cubic Möbius ladder. The sixteen-state transfer counts each labelled subset exactly once with a twisted trace; the row-swap commuting involution yields a ratio of two explicitly verified finite determinants. The formal t-series substitution and coefficient extraction prove the exact first nonzero cardinality coefficients for all n, including the n=3 exception. Direct independent-adjacency enumeration covers all subsets for 3<=n<=10; symbolic exact determinant identities and a transfer sweep through n=40 replayed successfully. Finite tests are never used to infer the infinite claim without the transfer proof.

value.rationale: Complete enumerative refinement of a classical natural domination invariant on an infinite canonical graph family, not an arbitrary slice. The answer exhibits a topologically meaningful constant/linear/quadratic change in optimum multiplicity by twist congruence, and counts every nonoptimal size as well. The 2012 known packing threshold and 2023 numerical minimum do not imply the cardinality polynomial or optimizer counts. The finite-state proof is substantive and reusable for other twisted boundary questions.
